acceptanceCriteria: Successful per-attempt reaps never emit the overall changed-nothing warning.
No expired/reaped lease preserves the existing no-change warning and no receipt truth.
Summary exposes completed reap count and actual child receipt identities where available without fabricating an aggregate receipt.
Replays, retained failures and child receipts remain accurately distinguished; actual reap and authority semantics are unchanged.
Retain disposable CLI regression and focused verification, integrate reviewed change and complete native ticket.
body: Owner requested https://github.com/beamfall/corvint/issues/372. No-argument reap survey returns NoChange but child reaps mutate; report aggregate honestly without invented parent receipt or atomicity.
title: Tasks reap: truthful survey and per-attempt mutation receipt summary
